utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Morning, all. Everyone on? Right, let's get going.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I'm here. Still no coffee, though. That broken coffee machine in the canteen is properly testing my patience.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Probably doing your blood pressure a favour.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: You'd think. Having the opposite effect, actually.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: I'm just hoping the weather sorts itself out for the weekend. Supposed to be going camping.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: In April? Brave.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, that's one word for it. Forecast changes every time I look.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Right, before we get the full shipping forecast, quick round of where we're at.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yep. Tested the relief valve yesterday and it's all fine now. That's sorted.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Lovely, cheers.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: I've swapped the filter on the power pack on one as well. All done.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Nice one.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: And my visit to Tollgate with the contractor, that's done. All signed off.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Good, thanks.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: I've got the downtime for the little water valve on two agreed with production. Scheduling's sorted.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: On the risk assessment for the little water valve on two, I've got the first half done. Working through the rest of it.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yep, with you.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: The jam clearance and sensor checks on the Main Outfeed Conveyor, though—I can't get on with those. Waiting on the permit to be signed.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Ah, right. Understood.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Pricey asked me to pass on that the near-miss write-up for the door switch on two is about halfway through.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Cheers. Sorry, was fighting the mute button there.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: You're coming through now. Right, new stuff this morning.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: We've got a pressure drop on the Boiler Feedwater Pump. That's the main thing from my end.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Hannah, can you investigate the pressure drop on the Boiler Feedwater Pump? Drop everything for that one.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll investigate it. Understood on the urgency.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Sorry, you clipped out for me. Which pump was that?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Boiler Feedwater Pump. Hannah's taking the pressure-drop investigation.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yep, that's mine. Everything else aside for that one.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Thanks.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: While we're on pressure—just an observation—I saw the pressure on the Stretch Wrapper dip for a few minutes. Came back on its own.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Oh, it recovered by itself?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah. Nothing outstanding from that, just what I saw.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Okay, cheers for the heads-up.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I'll recalibrate the sensors on the heater box on one at half two.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Half two, boss? Sorry, someone was talking outside here.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, at half two.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: I heard half two as well. Not just your headset this time.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: And I'll sort the permit to work and isolation for the line 2 guard for Monday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Monday for that, Reidy?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, Monday. That's holding production up so it needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Right, got you.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: There's also the purchase order for the IM1 hydraulic unit that needs chasing.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I'll chase the purchase order for the IM1 hydraulic unit tomorrow. Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Cheers, Saz.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: No worries. At least I can read that one on my screen without squinting.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: That's because I've finally made the font bigger.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: A genuine improvement, then. Anything else new we need in this morning?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Nothing else from me, no.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: No, that's me as well.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: All clear here. I can hear everyone now, at least.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Nothing more from my side.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Nor mine. I'll spare you the rest of the forecast.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Much appreciated. Right, thanks everyone. Leave it there.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cheers, all.
